# `kit` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "kit" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/kit/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required |  |
| `name` | string | required | Display name in tools and debug overlays. |
| `purpose` | `"walkable"` \| `"blocking"` \| `"climbable"` \| `"interactive"` \| `"hazard"` | required | Default purpose (greybox colour); a scene placement may override it. |
| `parts` | list of object (at least 1) | required | The shapes the piece is made of. |
| `parts[].shape` | `"box"` \| `"wedge"` | `"box"` | box, or wedge (a ramp rising towards +z). |
| `parts[].size` | list of any (at least 3) | required | Size of the part along x, y, z in metres (before placement scale). |
| `parts[].offset` | list of any (at least 3) | `[0,0,0]` | Centre of the part relative to the piece's origin (floor, footprint centre), metres. |
| `parts[].collider` | boolean | `true` | Whether the part is solid (gets a static collider). |
